paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar, son of Yose the Galilean, Mishnah Sotah 5:3. He formulated thirty-two interpretive measures; whenever his aggadah appears, make your ears like a funnel, Kissui Haddam, folio 89 [89a in the checked edition]. His brother Chanina: see his generation there. Zerikan and Yochanan in his name, Shemot Rabbah 1, 20; Vayikra Rabbah 19. Nechemyah in his name; Yudan in his name, Shir Hashirim Rabbah, “Who is she that looks forth.” Rav Huna in his name, Bereshit Rabbah 1, 28, 36, at ל״ע [locator unresolved], and 85. His burial: see Yose the Galilean.
